declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this statement for Ostrander Bell LLP in support of preliminary approval. In the first round, we proposed a $30 million class fund with automatic payments to identified members and a separately court-approved $5 million request for fees and expenses. We also proposed that any unawarded fees go to the class. Brightline countered with a $27 million class fund and a $4 million fee-and-expense request, retaining automatic payments and the provision directing unawarded fees to the class, with no clear-sailing provision. We accepted that offer in the second round. The complete negotiation transcript will be filed with the motion. Fees and class relief were discussed together from the first round; they were not negotiated only after class relief had been agreed. The $27 million fund provides direct recovery without a claims process and represents approximately 42% of the $64 million in disputed charges. In assessing the compromise, we considered our estimated 55% chance of a roughly $50 million trial award if the class prevailed, as well as certification risk, the possibility of no recovery, and the approximately two-to-three-year wait for trial. The proposed $4 million fee and expense award remains subject to the Court’s independent review. In my judgment, the settlement is fair, reasonable, and adequate for purposes of preliminary approval.
